scenes.title: Laves Graph and Dual
scenes.content: A unit cell of a Laves graph (green edges connecting white vertices) along with its dual mirror image (purple edges connecting yellow vertices). The other points of the sparsest integer lattice containing both are ccolored by equivalence class under the symmetries of the Laves graph.

scenes.title: Nearest Lattice Neighbors
scenes.content: In this scene, the vertices  of the Laves graph and its dual mirror image are joined to their nearest neighbors in the integer lattice (respectively by cyan and orange edges to red and blue vertices), showing that the integer lattice points fall into 4 classes based on taxicab distance to either the Laves graph or its dual.
